items.title: Drag the volume. Watch which architecture wins.
items.description: Reproduces the unit's own NotifyCo model: Option A (sync, just add servers) versus Option B (queue-buffered), including Option B's amortized $18,000 build cost and both options' expected outage cost. Drag monthly volume from today's 15M up toward the 45M year-end projection and watch the crossover — the point where Option B's cost drops below Option A's. Try dragging months since launch past 12 to see Option B's cost drop once its build cost is paid off.
items.compute: const volume = params.monthlyVolumeMillions * 1000000; const ABase = 0.00035, AScale = 80000000, BBase = 0.00035, BFixed = 200, BBuild = 18000, BAmortMonths = 12; const aInfra = ABase * (1 + volume / AScale) * volume; const amortized = params.monthsSinceLaunch <= BAmortMonths ? BBuild / BAmortMonths : 0; const bInfra = BBase * volume + BFixed + amortized; const aRisk = (params.outagesPerYear * 3000) / 12; const bRisk = (params.outagesPerYear * 300) / 12; return { costA: Math.round(aInfra + aRisk), costB: Math.round(bInfra + bRisk) };
